cases.name: Diane M. Psaros
cases.about: She and Brian owned Northwest Marketing Management. On Facebook, her mother Cathy Psaros wrote a loving tribute, "Diane Marie Psaros. Only 42 years old her life was cut short in a senseless, cruel act of violence. She was murdered along with her beloved fiancé, Brian Rolen and my grandson’s dog JoJo. Brian was the love of her life, a 6”5”” gentle giant. He saved her life, and they fell in love. She has left behind her precious son, Sean, sister Kristi, nieces Olivia, Arianna, Kayleigh & Courtney, cousins, extended family here and in England, Ireland and Wales. Her smile could light up a room. She was a giving, caring person, spending many years as a teacher, the profession she chose to make a difference. A gifted writer, painter and musician. She made the world a better place with her beautiful smile and loving gentle soul. To borrow somebody else’s words, that are fitting here, “she’s the most beautiful woman I have ever seen, and she’s pretty to look at too“. I feel like my life ended on December 20, 2023 when my precious daughter was taken from me. There are no words that could possibly describe the heartache & devastation that grips my soul, to know that I will never be able to hold her in my arms again or hear her laugh or see her beautiful smile. I will never see again her laugh and play with her beautiful son. I will never again see the way she looks at Brian and how Brian looks at her. Their love for each other shined bright, whether they were sitting around the campfire, snowmobiling, dancing or just cooking and doing the dishes together. They were in the beginning of what should’ve been a long and beautiful life together. They had been together for far too short of a time, but was one of the most amazing love stories I have ever seen. Going forward, my precious grandson, Sean, my daughter Kristi and my granddaughters, Olivia & Arianna will try to build a new life. Our hearts forever shattered. No mother ever loved a child more or was more proud of the amazing woman she grew up to be. She will be forever young in our hearts and minds, as the right to go grow old was stolen from her. My beautiful girl is now in the arms of the angels along with her beloved Brian and sweet, sweet JoJo."
